title: monardella linoides subsp. viminea
intro: Monardella linoides subsp. viminea, commonly known as Purple Mountain Monardella, is a plant species within the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is a shrubby perennial native to California, valued for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Monardella linoides subsp. viminea include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
